agent_summary:
Lane 62 (Error handling) on juice.lab.test, an OWASP Juice Shop (v20.2.0) behind nginx/1.30.5, reachable only over http (https/443 refused). Both checklist items were tested with read-only requests (61 requests total, above the depth floor).

WSTG-ERRH-02 (stack traces) — DONE, vulnerable: Several conditions return HTTP 500/406 with the full verbose Express error template containing complete Node.js stack traces that disclose absolute server paths (/juice-shop/build/routes/*.js, /juice-shop/build/lib/insecurity.js, /juice-shop/node_modules/express/...). Triggers observed: GET /rest/nonexistent-xyz (500), GET /redirect?to=http://evil.example.com (406), GET /rest/order-history (500, unauth), GET /rest/chatbot/status (500, unauth), GET /rest/track-order/ (500).

WSTG-ERRH-01 (improper error handling) — DONE, vulnerable: Error responses are verbose and highly inconsistent. GET /rest/products/search?q=')) leaks a raw SQLITE_ERROR DB-engine message; GET /api/Cards/abc, /rest/wallet/balance, /api/Addresss return an unhandled JS TypeError ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')"); unauthenticated endpoints return verbose HTML error pages disclosing "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)"; the same classes of error variously produce JSON vs HTML and 400/401/404/500; a forged JWT (Bearer a.b.c) is accepted as 200 {"user":{}}; and some paths (/api/Challenges, /rest/continue-code) are filtered at the proxy returning a plain nginx 404. Version is also disclosed at /rest/admin/application-version (20.2.0).

Leads recorded for other lanes: verbose stack-trace/version disclosure (medium); /metrics and /rest/memories exposing process metrics and full user records incl. password hashes/deluxeToken (medium); internal baseUrl http://localhost:3000 via /rest/admin/application-configuration and security.txt (low). Also seen in passing: /ftp directory listing and /encryptionkeys listing.

Nothing was left open; writes were not required (engagement is read-only).

leads.title: [agent] /metrics and /rest/memories expose sensitive data without authentication

detail.text: GET /metrics returns Prometheus metrics (process memory, CPU, fds, request counts) with no auth. GET /rest/memories returns full user records embedded in each memory, including password hashes, deluxeToken, email and role for users (e.g. admin bkimminich). Noted for the information-disclosure / access-control lanes, not error handling.

leads.title: [agent] Internal config and base URL disclosed via /rest/admin/application-configuration and security.txt

detail.text: GET /rest/admin/application-configuration (200) returns the full application config including server.baseUrl http://localhost:3000, chatbot model, privacy contact email and more, unauthenticated. /.well-known/security.txt discloses Csaf: http://localhost:3000/... internal URL. Noted for information-disclosure lane.

leads.title: [agent] Verbose error pages leak full stack traces, server file paths, DB engine and framework version

detail.text: Multiple error conditions on juice.lab.test (OWASP Juice Shop) return verbose errors. GET /rest/nonexistent-xyz -> HTTP 500 HTML with a full Express stack trace exposing absolute paths under /juice-shop/build/... and /juice-shop/node_modules/express/.... GET /redirect?to=http://evil.example.com -> 406 with another full stack trace (routes/redirect.js:54). GET /rest/products/search?q=')) -> 500 leaking raw "SQLITE_ERROR: near \")\": syntax error" (DB engine disclosure, also hints at SQLi). Unauthenticated endpoints return HTML error pages stating "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)". GET /rest/admin/application-version discloses version 20.2.0. These are improper error handling / information disclosure issues.
